Hong Kong's gold trade is watching Shuibei sell out of small gold pieces even as the price falls: Chow Tai Fook's gram price is down to RMB1,246, from RMB1,410 a month ago, after gold fell 3.96% in New York.

香港金飾業界正關注：深圳水貝小克重金飾現斷貨，金價本身卻在下跌。周大福金飾克價跌至1,246元人民幣，較一個月前的1,410元回落；此前紐約現貨金價下跌3.96%。
